landingRules: Do not merge a child PR before its parent PR has landed or the child has been correctly rebased/retargeted.
Do not squash or reorder protocol-layer commits in a way that changes frozen vectors or provenance history without a new audit.
After each parent lands, refresh the next PR base and re-check the diff before merging it.
A mergeable=true GitHub state is not equivalent to merge authorization.
Independent executor or deployment evidence cannot be used to silently mark GitHub CI as PASS.
The Actions diagnostic localizes the current blocker but does not itself satisfy the CI gate.
The diagnostic workflow remains manual-only until account/platform state changes, to avoid redundant failing probes.
Vercel bootstrap is preview-only and cannot be used to authorize production or stable promotion.
Landing RC1 code does not by itself authorize V1.0 stable or HNK_CANON promotion.
